status_legend.CM: Conditional mandatory - mandatory when `when` is true
status_legend.O: Optional - may be blank, format still checked when filled
status_legend.BLANK_FOR_NEW: Must be blank for NEW (APPL_TYPE 01) upload

pack_fill_legend.ALWAYS: Cosmos positive pack fills it on every row (user rule: fill every field a NEW record can carry)
pack_fill_legend.<expression>: Filled when the expression is true, blank otherwise

condition_syntax: Python-style expression over column names (string values). Helpers: no_other_rp_id() - true when none of the other 7 RP ID columns is filled; rp_doc_used(code) - true when REL_PER_ADD_PROF / REL_PER_CURR_ADD_PROOF / RP POI image uses that POA code.

NAME.desc: Letters only, single space between words. No digits/special characters (CERSAI allows single quote ' in father/spouse name only).

PLACE.desc: Plain place/branch name: letters, single spaces, no digits, no double space.

ENTITY_NAME.desc: Entity name: letters/digits and & ( ) . ' - with single spaces.

ADDRESS_LINE.desc: Address line: letters/digits, single spaces, no special characters (iFlow rule). Max 55.

CITY.desc: City/Town/Village: letters and single spaces. Max 50.

DATE.desc: DD-MM-YYYY and a real calendar date.

PIN.desc: 6 digits, must exist in CERSAI Pincode master; district + state must match that PIN.

STATE.desc: 2-char CERSAI State Master code (TN, MH, KA ...).

PAN.desc: PAN = 5 letters + 4 digits + 1 letter. 4th letter = holder type (P person, C company, F firm/LLP, T trust, H HUF, A AOP, B BOI, G govt, J AJP, L local authority).

PAN_OR_FORM60.desc: Either a valid PAN or the literal text FORM60.

AADHAAR.desc: 12 digits, first digit 2-9, Verhoeff checksum valid. No X/x/*, no spaces, no masking in the CSV (images show it masked XXXX XXXX 1234). CERSAI stores only last 4.

DRIVING_LICENCE.desc: DL: state code(2) + RTO(2) + issue year(4) + 7 digits = 15 chars (CERSAI max 20).

NREGA.desc: NREGA job card (pack format): state code(2) + 14 digits. CERSAI max 40 (applicant) / 20 (RP column).

NPR.desc: NPR letter reference - format NOT confirmed by CERSAI (max 20 alphanumeric). Not used in current packs.

LAST4_AADHAAR.desc: Exactly 4 digits = last 4 digits of the person's Aadhaar (E-KYC / Offline Aadhaar).

CIN.desc: CIN (21): L/U + 5-digit industry + state(2) + year(4) + PLC/PTC + 6 digits. Public Ltd (E) = L..PLC, Private Ltd (D) = U..PTC.

LLPIN.desc: LLP Identification Number: 3 letters + 4 digits (AAA-1234 / AAA1234).

GSTIN.desc: GSTIN (15): GST state code(2) + PAN(10) + entity no + Z + checksum. Chars 3-12 must equal PAN_OR_FORM60, first 2 = GST code of PERM_ADD_STATE.

REG_CERT.desc: Registration Certificate number: pack format REG + state(2) + year(4) + 6 digits (firms/trusts) OR the GSTIN (companies/LLPs).

DEEMED_11.desc: Utility bill consumer/bill no (pack format EB + 12 digits).

DEEMED_12.desc: Property / municipal tax receipt no (pack format PTR + 12 digits).

DEEMED_13.desc: Pension Payment Order no (pack format PPO + 12 digits).

DEEMED_14.desc: Allotment letter no (pack format ALT + 12 digits).

MOBILE_IN.desc: Indian mobile: 10 digits starting 6-9 (when ISD = 91). Else up to 20 digits.

ISD.desc: ISD code digits only (India = 91), no + sign.

IMAGE_FILE.desc: File name only (no folder), extension jpg/jpeg/pdf/tif/tiff; must exist in Common_Images/<CUSTOMER_REFERENCE_NUMBER>/ unless the image-processing summary says MISSING.

CKYC_NO_IND.desc: 14-digit CKYC number, first digit 1-6 = Individual (UPDATE only).

CKYC_NO_LE.desc: 14-digit CKYC number, first digit 7-9 = Legal Entity (UPDATE only).

ACC_TYPE.04: OTP based E-KYC (POI must be H)
ACC_TYPE.02: Small - NOT allowed for new upload
ACC_TYPE.03: Simplified - NOT allowed for new upload

DIS_FLAG.1: Differently abled (then DIS_TYPE, DIS_PERCENT, DIS_UDID_NUMBER mandatory)

MARITAL_STATUS.S: Single (pack convention; not a CERSAI upload field)

IDENTITY_CODE_LE.01: OVD of person authorised to transact (no ID no.)

POA_DEEMED_CURRENT.15: Self Declaration (only when POI&A is Aadhaar)

cross_field_rules.rule: CSV is pipe (|) delimited, UTF-8 (BOM allowed), first row = exact header of the persona (IND 99 / Minor 198 / LE 189 columns, same order), every data row has the same column count.
cross_field_rules.verify:
Open the CSV as text; count '|' per row; compare header with personas.

.header
cross_field_rules.negative: Row with 98 pipes -> 'Number of pipe separated records do not match'

cross_field_rules.rule: File name CKYC_DATA_IN_DDMMYYYY_NN.csv for Individual + Minor, CKYC_DATA_LE_DDMMYYYY_NN.csv for Legal Entity. Never mix IN and LE rows, never mix NEW (01) and UPDATE (03) rows in one file.
cross_field_rules.verify: File name regex + APPL_TYPE distinct values per file

cross_field_rules.rule: Series number NN is continuous across the packs of one day (IN 01..270, LE 01..90 for the 30-Sep set). Positive 20 records per IND/Minor CSV; LE 20 companies x 2 RP = 40 rows per CSV.
cross_field_rules.verify: List CSV names across packs; count records

cross_field_rules.rule: ORG_CODE = config.ORG_CODE (IN0308), ORG_NAME = config.ORG_NAME, BRID = config.BRID (001). On every RP row REL_PER_ORG_CODE = ORG_CODE and REL_PER_ORG_NAME = ORG_NAME - also in DVS.
CUSTOMER_REFERENCE_NUMBER unique across ALL packs and folders; REL_PER_CUST_ID unique; each Common_Images folder name = one customer.
cross_field_rules.verify: Collect all values across packs; duplicates = failure
cross_field_rules.negative: Same COSI30090001 in Pack1 and Pack2

cross_field_rules.rule: PAN (not FORM60), Aadhaar, Passport, Voter, DL, NREGA, DIN, CIN/LLPIN, GSTIN, deemed-proof numbers, mobile and e-mail are unique per person across all packs. The same number may repeat only inside one person's own record (POI = POA = COMM proof when it is the same document).
cross_field_rules.verify: Map value -> set of owners (customer or RP id); >1 owner = failure
cross_field_rules.negative: Two different customers with PAN ABCPK1234L

cross_field_rules.rule: At least one of father / spouse / mother name is given. FORS_FLG 01 -> father's name in FATHERORSPOUSE_*; 02 -> spouse's name. When FORS_FLG is set, prefix + first name are mandatory.
Prefix matches gender: MR -> M; MRS/MS/MISS -> F. FORS_FLG 02 (spouse) only with MRS. For RP: REL_PER_FATHERORSPOUSE 02 only for female RP, and then maiden name is filled.
RP mother name (prefix + first name) always filled on every RP row.
All dates DD-MM-YYYY and real calendar dates. DOB / DATE_OF_INC / DECL_DATETIME / KYC_VERIFY_DATETIME (and RP equivalents) are not future dates and not equal to the upload date. DOB < DECL_DATETIME.
cross_field_rules.verify: CSV date columns vs upload date

cross_field_rules.rule: POI/POA expiry date filled only for Passport (A/02) and Driving Licence (D/03) and must be later than KYC_VERIFY_DATETIME. Blank for Aadhaar, Voter, NREGA.
DATE_OF_COMMENCEMENT >= DATE_OF_INC and not future.
Individual (ACC_TYPE 01, MINOR N): age at DECL_DATETIME >= 18.
Minor: ACC_TYPE 05, MINOR Y, age < 18 at DECL_DATETIME. Minor With RP pack: age 1-17. Minor Without RP pack: age 11-17 (user rule).
Every related person (guardian, director, partner, trustee) is >= 18 at REL_PER_DECL_DATETIME.

Every address block (permanent, correspondence/local, RP permanent, RP current): PIN exists in masters/pincode_master.csv, district = master district of that PIN, state = master state of that PIN (case-insensitive). Country IN.

PERM_TO_COMM_FLG = Y -> correspondence/local address lines 1-3, city, district, state, country, PIN are an exact copy of the permanent address and COMM_ADDRESS_TYPE is blank. Flag = N -> a different address (line 1 or PIN differs) with all mandatory lines filled and (IND/Minor) COMM_ADDRESS_TYPE in 01-05.
cross_field_rules.verify: Compare PERM_* vs COMM_* column by column
cross_field_rules.negative: Flag Y but COMM_Add_Pin differs; flag N but COMM equals PERM

cross_field_rules.rule: REL_PER_SAMEASPERM_ADD_FLAG = Y -> REL_PER_CURR_ADD_* is an exact copy of REL_PER_ADD_* and REL_PER_CURR_ADD_PROOF = REL_PER_ADD_PROF. Flag = N -> a different current address, all mandatory current lines filled, REL_PER_CURR_ADD_PROOF filled.
cross_field_rules.negative: Flag N with current address = permanent

cross_field_rules.rule: Guardian lives with the minor: REL_PER_ADD_LINE1..PIN/STATE = minor's PERM_ADD_LINE1..PIN/STATE.
cross_field_rules.negative: Guardian permanent PIN different from minor's

cross_field_rules.rule: POI_TYPE, POI_CATEGORY, POI_NUMBER and POI_FILE_NAME describe the same document (doc_map): e.g. E -> 'Proof of Possession of Aadhaar' -> 12-digit Verhoeff Aadhaar -> Aadhar.jpg. POI_NUMBER format = number_format_by_code.POI_TYPE.
POA_TYPE, POA_CATEGORY, POA_NUMBER, POA_FILE_NAME describe the same document. PERM_ADD_PROOF = POA_TYPE. PERM_ADD_PROOF_DESC (if filled) = POA master name.

If POI and POA are the same document (E/01, A/02, D/03, B/04, F/05; LE 02/06, 03/07) then POI_NUMBER = POA_NUMBER and POI_FILE_NAME = POA_FILE_NAME (one image). If different documents then numbers and file names differ.
cross_field_rules.negative: POI E + POA 01 with two different Aadhaar numbers

cross_field_rules.rule: A minor never uses Voter ID (POI B / POA 04) or Driving Licence (POI D / POA 03) for POI, POA or correspondence proof. Minor pool = Aadhaar, Passport, NREGA.
PAN_OR_FORM60 / REL_PER_PANORFORM60 = valid PAN pattern or FORM60. Individual/RP PAN 4th letter P. LE 4th letter by constitution (D/E C, B/J F, H T).
PAN 5th letter = first letter of the holder's last name (Individual/RP) or of the entity name (LE).
cross_field_rules.negative: Last name SHAH with PAN ABCPK1234L

cross_field_rules.rule: COMM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY / COMM_ADDRESS_IDTYPE / COMM_ADDRESS_NUMBER always filled. Flag Y -> same document as POA (IDTYPE = POA_TYPE, NUMBER = POA_NUMBER, CATEGORY = POA_CATEGORY). Flag N -> NEVER an OVD: deemed proof 11 Utility Bill / 12 Property or Municipal Tax Receipt / 13 Pension Payment Order (age >= 58 only) / 14 Letter of Allotment of Accommodation, number EB/PTR/PPO/ALT + 12 digits, category = deemed_map name. Minor flag N -> 11 or 12 only.
LE COMM_ADDRESS_IDTYPE in 06/07/99 only and (pack) = POA_TYPE; COMM_ADDRESS_NUMBER = POA_NUMBER; COMM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY = POA master name of POA_TYPE.
At least one RP ID column is filled (REL_PER_UID, _VOTER, _NREGA, _PASSPORT, _DRIVING, _POPULATION_LET, _EKYC, _OFFLINE_UID). Each filled column must match its format.

cross_field_rules.source: CERSAI Detail(40) 55/65 ('ID number needs to be provided in fields 35 to 43')
cross_field_rules.rule: The document of REL_PER_ADD_PROF, the document shown in REL_PER_POI_NAME and (flag N) the document of REL_PER_CURR_ADD_PROOF each have their number in the matching RP ID column (01 UID, 02 PASSPORT, 03 DRIVING, 04 VOTER, 05 NREGA, 08 POPULATION_LET, 09 EKYC, 10 OFFLINE_UID).
RP flag N: REL_PER_CURR_ADD_PROOF is a different document from REL_PER_ADD_PROF and from the RP POI document (different address -> different proof).
REL_PER_EKYC / REL_PER_OFFLINE_UID = exactly 4 digits = last 4 digits of REL_PER_UID.

REL_PER_PHOTO_NAME = RP{n}_Photo.jpg; REL_PER_POI_NAME = RP{n}_<doc image> of the RP POI document; REL_PER_PER_ADDRESS_NAME = RP{n}_<doc image> of REL_PER_ADD_PROF. n = RP order inside the customer (1, 2).
02_Minor_With_RP: REL_TYPE=1, ADD_DEL_REL_PER=01, full guardian block. 03_Minor_Without_RP: every RP column (DECEASED_DATE..REL_PER_CURR_ADDRESS_NAME) blank except CUST_ID.

CERSAI expects ACC_TYPE 05 records to carry a Guardian (REL_TYPE 1). The 03_Minor_Without_RP folder is a deliberate scenario (minor 11-17 operating own account) - confirm the expected outcome with the Cosmos team.
CUST_ID = CUSTOMER_REFERENCE_NUMBER of the parent (minor / entity). LE continuation row: CUST_ID = the entity row's CUSTOMER_REFERENCE_NUMBER.
cross_field_rules.negative: CUST_ID not found in any entity row

cross_field_rules.rule: Multi-RP: row 1 = entity + RP1; rows 2..N = continuation rows where every column before REL_TYPE is BLANK and only the RP block is filled, linked by CUST_ID. NUM_OF_REL_PER = number of rows with that CUST_ID.
cross_field_rules.negative: Entity name repeated on RP2 row

cross_field_rules.source: CERSAI Related Person Type + Constitution rules
cross_field_rules.rule: REL_TYPE by constitution: D/E -> 4 Director (REL_PER_DIN_NUMBER 8 digits mandatory), B/J -> 8 Partner, H -> 7 Trustee. DIN blank when REL_TYPE != 4.

POI_TYPE 02 (COI) or 03 (Registration Certificate) - never an Individual code. POA_TYPE 06/07/99 = PERM_ADD_PROOF. COI number: CIN for D/E (U..PTC for D, L..PLC for E), LLPIN for J; B/H have no COI (Registration Certificate only). Registration Certificate number: REG format (B/H) or GSTIN (D/E/J).
TIN (GSTIN) checksum valid, chars 3-12 = PAN_OR_FORM60, first 2 digits = GST state code of PERM_ADD_STATE, TIN_COUNTRY = IN.

LE contact duplicates are equal: RES_TEL_CODE = RESIDENCE_TELEPHONE_NO_STD_CODE, RES_TEL_NUM = RESIDENCE_TELEPHONE_NO, OFF_TEL_* = OFFICE_*, MOB_ISD_CODE/MOB_NUM = MOBILE_NO_ISD_CODE/MOBILE_NO, FAX_* = FAX_NO_*. NUM_OF_IMG = 01 when POI file = POA file else 02. Entity name suffix matches constitution.
Legal entity never has a photograph: no Photo.jpg in the entity folder. Only RPs have RP{n}_Photo.jpg.
STD code and telephone number both filled or both blank (residence, office, fax). ISD code and mobile both filled or both blank; ISD 91 -> mobile 10 digits starting 6-9.
Every customer in every CSV (all 3 folders) has a folder Common_Images/<CUSTOMER_REFERENCE_NUMBER>/ (for LE the entity CUSTOMER_REFERENCE_NUMBER; RP images sit in the same folder).

01_POSITIVE and 02_DVS: every file named in PHOTO_FILE_NAME / POI_FILE_NAME / POA_FILE_NAME / REL_PER_PHOTO_NAME / REL_PER_POI_NAME / REL_PER_PER_ADDRESS_NAME exists in the customer folder, and the folder has no extra files. 03_IMAGE_PROCESSING: file exists exactly when IMAGE_STATUS_SUMMARY.csv says AVAILABLE and is absent when it says MISSING.
cross_field_rules.negative: Aadhar.jpg named in CSV but not in folder (positive)

cross_field_rules.source: Cosmos DOCUMENT naming (user rule) / Document Master
cross_field_rules.rule: Image file name = document of its column: Photo.jpg (02), Aadhar.jpg (04), Passport.jpg (05), DrivingLicense.jpg (06), VoterID.jpg (07), NREGA.jpg (08), IncorporationCertificate.jpg (19), RegistrationCertificate.jpg (20); RP files prefixed RP1_/RP2_. LEGACY naming alternative: {CUST}_{DocCode}_{Photo|POI|POA|POIA}_{page}.jpg.

02_DVS: every record carries at least one deliberate defect; SUMMARY.csv column DVS_DEFECT_FIELD names it (plus RP current-address proof ID in wrong format for RP flag N rows). Automation must see the record rejected/held with an error on that field. Everything else in the record is valid.
cross_field_rules.verify: SUMMARY.csv DVS_DEFECT_FIELD vs DVS Maker / CERSAI error

cross_field_rules.rule: 03_IMAGE_PROCESSING: CSV data fully valid (same rules as positive); only images are partially missing (photo / POI / POA each AVAILABLE or MISSING, incl. RP images). Expected: record routed to image-upload / image-processing queue for the MISSING files only.
